title: festuca pauneroi
intro: Festuca pauneroi, commonly known as Paunero's fescue, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Festuca pauneroi include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Festuca pauneroi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
